meta.name: add-gchat
meta.description: Add Google Chat channel integration via Chat SDK.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 通过 Chat SDK 为应用接入 Google Chat 渠道。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你正在开发应用并想让它能收发 Google Chat 消息。
copy.tagline_en: Add Google Chat integration to your app via the Chat SDK.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're building an app and need Google Chat messaging.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 可按你的要求把 Google Chat 适配器复制进代码仓库、注册并安装固定版本依赖，然后构建并运行一条测试。要让消息真正送达，还需你按它的提示在 Google Cloud 控制台完成人工配置（创建服务账号、填凭据等）。
howto.when: 当你说出要“添加 Google Chat 通道”或“集成 gchat”之类的请求时触发，通常发生在已有代码仓库的工作目录中。

say.text: 帮我把这个项目接入 Google Chat。
say.note: Claude 会开始执行 add-gchat 的整套步骤。

say.text: 请将 Google Chat 适配器加到代码库并安装依赖。
say.note: 对应复制文件、注册和安装包的动作。

say.text: 我准备好服务账号凭据了，请配置并验证。
say.note: 它会提示粘贴 JSON 到 .env 并运行测试。

howto.what_en: When installed, Claude can, on request, copy the Google Chat adapter into the codebase, register it, install a pinned dependency, build, and run a test. For messages to actually arrive, you must still complete manual Google Cloud setup (service account, credentials) as prompted.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to add a Google Chat channel or integrate gchat, typically in a working directory with an existing repository.

say_en.text: Set up Google Chat for this project.
say_en.note: Claude runs the full add-gchat flow.

say_en.text: Add the Google Chat adapter and its dependency.
say_en.note: Copies, registers, and installs the package.

say_en.text: I have the service account JSON, configure and verify it.
say_en.note: Prompts for the JSON, writes .env, runs tests.
